name: xlxz-markdown-editor
description: Obsidian-quality Markdown live preview editor — microkernel architecture with pluggable extensions

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --format esm --target browser --external vue && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.cjs --format cjs --target browser --external vue && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration
